SDNA1.label: Other - not access related

SDNA1.1.label: Product and/or sales inquiry
SDNA1.1.description: Definition: Use for product availability, pricing, purchasing or general commercial questions.

SDNA1.2.label: autorenewal for D2R subscripton
SDNA1.2.description: Definition: Use for requests concerning automatic renewal of a D2R subscription.

SDNA1.3.label: Not for SD
SDNA1.3.description: Definition: Use when the request belongs to another Elsevier product, service or support team.

SDNA1.4.label: Not enough info
SDNA1.4.description: Definition: Use when the request is clearly non-access-related but its precise topic is unclear.

SDNA1.5.label: Other
SDNA1.5.description: Definition: Use for another non-access request not listed below.

SDNA1.6.label: Content issue
SDNA1.6.description: Definition: Use for questions, errors or corrections concerning the scientific or editorial content itself.

SDNA1.7.label: Billing / invoice
SDNA1.7.description: Definition: Use for invoices, receipts, payments, refunds or other billing matters.

SDNA1.8.label: Request to remove personal information
SDNA1.8.description: Definition: Use when the customer asks to remove specific personal data without deleting the whole account.

SDNA1.9.label: Sales request COA
SDNA1.9.description: Definition: Use for a COA request that must be handled by Sales rather than access support.

SDNA1.10.label: Request for information
SDNA1.10.description: Definition: Use when the customer asks how to find, obtain or access content without reporting a failure.

SDNA1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Other - not access related'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when the request is unrelated to accessing or managing access to ScienceDirect, with signals such as publishing, manuscript submission, scientific questions, content corrections, invoices, sales, or author contact.
